provenance_note: From a multi-sign interior wayfinding package. All client, vendor, designer, building/department names, street address, project numbers, and the ADA-assistance phone number excluded at extraction. Higher-education vertical retained. Copy content excluded; copy structure retained.

program_model.instance_model: one header design fabricated in a few standard widths (sign-type codes S1H/S2H/S3H), each deployed in quantity over existing room signs; copy and building color vary per unit

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A built-up acrylic header band that slides over the top of an existing room sign and is glued in place, adding a painted, direct-printed department or building identifier above the existing message. Built from a 1/8in router-cut acrylic face, a spacer, and a backer laminated together; front and edges painted; finished with a non-glare ADA clear coat.
knowledge.rationale: A slide-over header lets a department be re-identified or rebranded without replacing the whole existing sign, which is cheap, fast, and field-installable across a large quantity of doors.
knowledge.tradeoffs: Retrofit headers are low-cost and minimally disruptive, but depend on a consistent host-sign top profile and add a visible seam where the header meets the existing sign.
knowledge.when_to_use: Campus or facility re-identification programs where existing room signs are sound and only the header/department band needs to change.

structure.construction: 1/2in built-up acrylic header: 1/8in router-cut acrylic face and notch, 1/4in spacer, and 1/8in backer laminated together; slides over existing sign and is glued in place

materials_manifest.product: Matthews (MAP) SOA 4158SP ADA non-glare clear coat

dimensions.note: Three coded header widths; heights ~7-9in. Package states sizes need not be finalized prior to fabrication.

copy_blocks.treatment: single line, direct-print on painted band

compliance.notes: ADA non-glare clear coat (P8) applied on all interior signs per the package key.

rules_observations: Header is a subordinate band sized to a consistent host-sign profile, holding system consistency across the program.
craft_observations: Laminated build-up (face/spacer/backer) gives a dimensional reveal rather than a flat printed strip; glued slide-over keeps fasteners concealed.

aesthetic_notes.note: A pragmatic retrofit device; success depends on uniform host signs so the seam reads as intentional.
